structures.description: Post-spike trading range: after the 2850 spike high (bar 71) the market spent 46 bars rotating between roughly 2633 and 2805, with overlapping bodies, alternating closes and no acceptance outside the band. Upper reference is bar 74's high; lower reference is bar 89's low, retested near 2637 (bar 112) and 2643.44 (bar 111).

Failed bull breakout attempt: bar 71 (O 2658.81) spiked to 2850 and closed 2723.15; bar 72 reached 2795 but closed 2754.31. No close followed above 2800, and bars 75-85 gave the move back to 2641.37, so the breakout was never accepted. Exact spike high 2850 (bar 71) is above the range's working upper reference 2804.59.

Latest up-leg and reversal bar: bars 111-119 built higher lows (2643.44, 2637, 2652.27) and closed up to 2732.01 (bar 119), then bar 120 printed H 2742.12 (a marginal ~25-bar high above bar 95's 2740.42) and reversed to close 2671.58, engulfing the bodies of bars 118-119. One bar only; no follow-through yet.

evidence_for: Bars 75-120 (46 bars) remain inside 2633.31-2804.59 with overlapping bodies and no two consecutive closes outside that band.
Range extremes were rejected within a few bars in both directions: 2804.59 (bar 74) to 2648.49 (bar 84); 2633.31 (bar 89) back to 2694.09 (bar 91).
The 2850 spike (bar 71) was not accepted: bar 72 topped at 2795 and no close printed above 2800 for the following 49 bars.
Recent bars are small and two-sided: bars 98-103 all close between 2683.22 and 2691.88 with 0.76-8.66-point bodies, versus the 98-point body of bar 12.
Highs after the spike form a flattening sequence (2850, 2804.59, 2786.81, 2740.42, 2742.12) while lows hold near 2633.31-2652.27, i.e. rotation rather than a directional trend.
evidence_against: The window's dominant swing is still bullish: 2358.62 (bar 37) to 2850 (bar 71), about +20%, with two spike legs and higher swing lows; the 46-bar range sits above that leg's midpoint near 2604, a common bull-flag position.

Higher lows inside the range (2633.31 bar 89, then 2637 bar 112, 2643.44 bar 111, 2652.27 bar 117) plus the highest close since bar 95 at 2732.01 (bar 119) support a bull-channel/flag continuation instead of neutral two-sided balance.

Bar 120 is a strong bear reversal bar (O 2732.01 C 2671.58, 1.58 above the low) that erased the bodies of bars 118-119; followed through, it would favor a bearish lower high after the 2850 spike rather than a balanced range.
The lower-high sequence is not clean: bar 120's high 2742.12 is above bar 95's 2740.42, and one reversal bar cannot define range edges.
transition_conditions: Acceptance above 2804.59: one close above it followed by a second close above 2804.59 would shift the read to a bull breakout in breakout-spike phase.
Acceptance below 2633.31: a close below 2633.31 with the next bar also closing below it would mark a bear breakout of the 46-bar range and a lower-high/lower-low structure after the 2850 spike.
Bar 120 follow-through: another close below 2670 with a high below 2742.12 reinforces the bear reversal; a close back above 2742.12 or 2732.56 voids it.
Continued overlap of closes between 2643.44 and 2742.12 for the next 5-10 bars keeps the range/two-sided classification and the low Always-In relevance.
